name: Implicit Octree Traversal
definition: A traversal method that builds a sparse octree using Morton coordinates to represent nodes. It samples the distance field to find surface crossings, places vertices at leaf centers, and traverses leaf nodes to invoke a callback for each 2x2x2 cube of neighboring leaf vertices.
summary: Implicit Octree Traversal constructs sparse octrees from distance fields using Morton coordinates to define hierarchy, enabling efficient isosurface extraction without storing explicit parent pointers.
